# Flyer Distribution Hampshire

> Flyer Distribution Hampshire is an independent local leaflet and flyer distribution business based in Hampshire, UK. We deliver printed marketing materials door-to-door through letterboxes across Hampshire and Dorset, helping local businesses reach real households in targeted postcode areas.

## About

Flyer Distribution Hampshire is a local, owner-operated business serving businesses of all sizes across Hampshire and Dorset. Unlike national operators, we provide a personal, reliable service with postcode-level targeting and campaign tracking. Our distributors are vetted, trained, and know their routes thoroughly.

We work with restaurants, tradespeople, estate agents, gyms, retailers, charities, and community organisations.

Contact: flyerdistributionhampshire@gmail.com
Website: https://flyerdistributionhampshire.co.uk

## Services

- **Design, Print and Deliver** — Full end-to-end service covering design, printing (A6, A5, A4, DL), and door-to-door distribution across Hampshire and Dorset. Most popular package.
- **Print and Deliver** — For customers with an existing design. We handle printing (A6, A5, A4, DL) and distribution through letterboxes.
- **Leaflet Distribution** — Door-to-door delivery to households across chosen postcode areas in Hampshire and Dorset.
- **Targeted Postcode Campaigns** — Postcode-data-driven distribution focused on areas most likely to respond to a specific campaign.
- **Vehicle Leaflet Distribution** — Leaflets placed on parked cars in car parks, retail areas, and high-footfall locations across Hampshire and Dorset.
- **Campaign Planning** — Bespoke campaign strategy built around the client's business, customers, budget, and timeline.

## Coverage Areas

Primary areas: Southampton, Bournemouth, Poole, Winchester, Eastleigh, New Forest, Romsey, Ringwood, Christchurch, Hythe, Totton, Hedge End, Chandler's Ford.

Southampton postcodes: SO14, SO15, SO16, SO17, SO18, SO19, SO30, SO31, SO40, SO45.

Geographic range: Hampshire and Dorset corridor, from Winchester in the north to Poole in the west.

Additional postcodes available on request.

## Key Facts

- Minimum recommended campaign size: 5,000 leaflets (sufficient reach for a meaningful response rate; discounted packages available at this volume)
- Leaflet sizes accepted: A6, A5, A4, DL
- Quote turnaround: within 24 hours of enquiry
- Campaign completion: most campaigns completed within two weeks of receiving materials
- Tracking: every campaign is tracked; completion is confirmed before invoicing
- Pricing: free, no-obligation quotes at https://flyerdistributionhampshire.co.uk/quote

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What areas do you cover?**
Hampshire and Dorset, including Southampton, Bournemouth, Poole, Winchester, Eastleigh, New Forest, Romsey, Ringwood, Christchurch, Hythe, Totton, Hedge End, and Chandler's Ford. Additional postcodes available on request.

**How does leaflet distribution work?**
Printed leaflets are posted directly through letterboxes across chosen postcode areas. Our vetted distributors carry out the rounds and confirm completion.

**Do you offer a full design, print and delivery service?**
Yes. Our end-to-end Design, Print and Deliver package covers artwork through to final distribution.

**Can I target specific postcode areas?**
Yes. Postcode-level targeting is central to how we work. Customers choose their target postcodes and we focus the campaign there.

**Do I need to have my leaflets printed already?**
No. We can handle printing (A6, A5, A4, DL) through our print partners at competitive rates, or customers can supply their own materials.

**How many leaflets do I need?**
We recommend a minimum of 5,000 for campaigns that need to generate a measurable response. We can advise on quantities for specific target areas as part of Campaign Planning.

**How long does a campaign take?**
Most campaigns are completed within two weeks of receiving materials. Smaller campaigns often turn around faster.

**What is vehicle leaflet distribution?**
Leaflets placed on parked cars in car parks, retail areas, and high-footfall locations. Works well alongside a door-to-door campaign.
